_paths_note: fight_odds_csv and player_odds_csv are hand-entered; ingest.py writes them fresh for a new card
_name_aliases_note: odds-file name -> DraftKings name, for fighters the matcher cannot resolve on its own
_lineup_generation_note: MIP settings (12000 solves / boost 1.4 / projection_share 0.35) are the fallback when the pool is generated by solves; the field now uses the enumerated universe (generate_lineups.py --universe), where the fitted field model sets every lineup's frequency.
_field_note: model fitted = Poisson log-linear copies model from scripts/mma/build_dupe_model.py --universe (every valid lineup of the card, zeros included; features salary left, exact cap, summed win prob, log rank by win prob, main-event count; Gamma(alpha) lumpiness at the top). Pool: scripts/mma/generate_lineups.py --universe. On the 2026-10-10 mini-MAX it reproduces unique lineups, max copies, top-100 share and one-offs within a few percent (ownership MAE 4.4, Spearman 0.87). original = the hand-set exponential + win boost.
_scoring_note: sig_strike 0.8 / time_exponent 0.5 fitted 2026-10-17 on the 23 real fighter scores of the 2026-10-10 card (scripts/mma/get_contest_data.py side table): the original 0.4 / 1.5 ran 23 pts low on winners and 12 on losers. Outcome probabilities (how a fight ends, who wins) come from the odds only; this layer is just points per outcome.
